disposition_reason: Prints mean and SD of lead and cadmium for 12 canned tomato paste products bought in Derna, Libya, expressed per litre of digest solution.

study.design: market survey, 12 canned tomato paste products of different brands and origins
study.origin: Libya (4), Italy (7), China (1) as listed in Table 1
study.method: AAS after hot-plate digestion of 0.5 g paste with 5 mL concentrated HNO3, diluted to 50 mL
study.qa: none reported (no CRM, recovery, blanks or LOD)
